declaration.preface:
Gautam Solar Private Limited is committed to conducting its operations in an environmentally responsible and sustainable manner. As a leading organization in the solar energy sector, the Company recognizes its responsibility to minimize environmental impacts while contributing to the global transition towards clean energy.

The Company aligns its environmental strategy with internationally recognized frameworks such as the Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) Standards and the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), ensuring transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in sustainability performance.
declaration.declaration: Gautam Solar Private Limited is committed to the following:
declaration.scope: This Environmental & Sustainability Policy is applicable across all Gautam Solar Private Limited employees, workers, contractors, sub-contractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders globally, including the communities in which Gautam Solar Private Limited operates. It ensures that environmental standards are consistently maintained throughout all its sites, operations, and business relationships.

Energy & GHG Emissions: Improve energy efficiency and increase renewable energy adoption
Increase the share of renewable energy in total energy consumption
Monitor and manage greenhouse gas emissions across Scope 1 and Scope 2, Scope 3
Water Management: Promote responsible water usage, conservation, and reuse
Monitor water consumption and discharge to ensure compliance
Reduce dependency on freshwater sources through alternative solutions
Materials, Chemicals & Waste: Minimize waste and ensure safe handling of materials and chemicals
Promote recycling and reuse of materials wherever feasible
Reduce the use of hazardous substances in operations and products
Product Use: Enhance product efficiency and reduce lifecycle impacts
Provide guidance to customers on efficient and safe product usage
Continuously innovate to enhance product sustainability performance
Product End-of-Life: Promote recyclability and circular economy practices
Integrate circular economy principles into product design
Reduce environmental impact associated with product disposal
Customer Health & Safety: Monitor and address product-related safety incidents
Continuously improve product safety and quality standards
Compliance: Adhere to environmental laws and regulations
Establish internal controls to manage environmental risks
Promote ethical and transparent environmental practices
Continuous Improvement: Encourage employee participation in sustainability initiatives
Continuously enhance environmental management systems and practices

targets.target: Renewable Energy Share: 50% of total energy consumption
Energy Efficiency: 15% improvement per unit production
Water Recycling & Reuse: Minimum 30% reuse across operations
Waste Diversion from Landfill: 90% of total waste
Chemical Compliance: 100% compliance with applicable standards
Critical Safety Incidents: Zero incidents annually

policy.monitoring: The Company shall monitor progress against defined targets through internal assessments, performance tracking, and audits.
policy.reviewMechanism:
This policy and its associated targets shall be reviewed annually by the EHS Head and top management to ensure:

Continued relevance

Alignment with regulatory requirements

Achievement of environmental objectives

Identification of improvement opportunities

Corrective and preventive actions shall be implemented wherever required.
